text: [Mira/canvas-v3fe] Implemented three discrete designed view modes (Document/Card/Tile) for plan, spec-section and task nodes. Document=full markdown (RichMarkdown mermaid/code)+badges; Card=title+ready/count badges+1-2 line plain digest; Tile=title+status glyph+counts. Text FIXED readable size per mode — removed continuous counter-scale (.ct-canvas-node/title font curves + --ct-canvas-zoom var deleted). Switching mode swaps layout, not font scale.

[DECISION] Layout is mode-aware so a node reserves EXACTLY its mode's bounded frame -> no empty shells, no overflow by construction (proven by layout/viewModes.test.ts). Fixed heights: tile 56, planCard 132, specCard 92, taskCard 104; document = content-fit estimate. Plan-row anchors collapse to node mid-edges in Card/Tile (no rows there) so spec/task edges never float. Auto-by-distance bands: far(<0.45)->Tile, mid->Card, near(>=0.85)->Document — document threshold lowered from LOD's 1.1 so the reading view appears at ~100% not only past 110%. Text-off FORCES Tile (deliberate declutter, never an accidental empty box). Default setting = auto, user-lockable. Per-node override map (nodeModeOverrides + modeFor) is plumbed but no per-node UI yet — global is the right default and per-node wasn't cheap given layout coupling.

[TESTING] All gates green. New tests added: viewMode.test.ts (auto bands + text-off->Tile), cards/viewModes.test.tsx (per-mode render invariants: body/digest/title presence, never empty), layout/viewModes.test.ts (per-mode box sizing == fixed heights + no node-node overlap in all 3 modes). Also fixed a pre-existing duplicate parent_task_id in Task type+fixtures that had tsc red on the branch.

[status_update] §20.3 Banded Multi-Column task layout landed (cc6d6b93). Replaced the single tall task column (the портянka) with a bounded grid anchored to section rows: tasks band by primary covered section, wrap across <=3 cols, top-down non-overlap sweep hugs each band to its row Y. Subtasks=super-cell; step clusters now FOLD BELOW the card as interior height (uniform taskWidth cells -> clean grid, no horizontal sprawl). On a 38-task dogfood-scale fixture: height ~1412 vs ~2812 single-col, <=3 cols, zero overlap, deterministic. New layout/taskBands.ts; intraPlan shrank to 164 lines. Makes the view-modes readable (the 13% fit-to-view portянka is gone). tsc clean, all canvas suites green, cargo+clippy pass.

[status_update] §23.2 STEP 2 landed (eb15b584): fixed task-cell sizes per mode (Tile 200x72/Card 260x120/Doc 260x320+bounded step interior) — banded <=3-col grid right of the plan node, top-down non-overlap, edges bezier from rail OUTPUT dot -> task. Thread&Coil steps now INTERIOR to the card (no separate milestone nodes): Tile=dots, Card=dots+count, Document=step CARDS with milestone TEXT+iteration (fixes 'steps are just dots' bug). NEW §23.6 distance-gated internal scroll: node body only intercepts wheel when zoomed IN (scale>=1) AND can scroll; at boundary or zoomed out -> canvas pans (no trap). Removed the always-on stopPropagation that fought panning. tsc clean, 11 canvas suites green (TaskSteps per-mode, fixed cell w/h, interior-steps layout, 3 scroll-gate cases), vite clean. Banded grid kills the tall column + makes section->task legible. STEP 3 next (mount focus@90%, presets, dbl-click focus+dim+breadcrumb, minimap, SectionChunk>30).

Tile plan-node nit fixed (57029ec0): removed the oversized green coverage panel; Tile body is now a compact SECTION INDEX (ready glyph · title · [n]), rows evenly distributed to align with the rail output dots. Coverage stays as the compact header bar. Tile now reads as a section index (matching Card=index+digests / Document=full bodies). tsc clean, canvas suites green, vite clean. Ready for Dax review.
SUPERSEDED: §24.1 removed node view modes — ONE canvas, content adapts to zoom
